full_prompt_en: A square fantasy painting brings a close group of rabbit-like travelers together against a dim, crowded background. Warm russet red clothing occupies much of the lower half, while the upper corners close in with dark blue green forms and layered ears. On the left, a large pale animal face turns outward beneath a rounded red leather cap. Its glossy black eye, fine whiskers and softly brushed cream muzzle contrast with the rigid cap seams and the row of metal buttons on its high-collared red coat. Near the center front, a smaller figure with a warm orange forehead and one gray upright ear looks toward the left. It wears a fitted red jacket with small bright fasteners and a diagonal strap; a small pale hand reaches forward around a thin dark rod. Behind this figure, another face sits partly hidden in shadow between the larger companions. The right foreground holds a white-faced figure beneath a tall folded crimson hat. A round metallic lens or goggle sits across its forehead, and gold-toned fittings, cords and a blue gray garment crowd the space around its shoulder. Slender whiskers and small dark eyes keep the animals gentle even as their uniforms and equipment look elaborate. At the far left edge, dark hands and an angled narrow object overlap the large red coat, adding another tight foreground layer without opening the scene into a broad setting. The light comes softly from the upper left and front, touching muzzles, hat leather, brass details and jacket buttons while leaving the space behind the group nearly black. Subtle brush texture and glazed shadow make fur, cloth and metal feel distinct; edges sharpen around eyes and fittings and soften where bodies merge into the dim background. The overall composition is intimate and theatrical, with large rounded heads, crowded accessories and restrained red, cream and blue green forming a curious storybook atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻绘画把一群兔形旅伴紧紧聚在昏暗而拥挤的背景前。暖锈红色衣物占据下半幅大部分区域，上方角落则被深蓝绿色形体和层叠的耳朵围拢。左侧，一张较大的浅色动物面孔从圆润的红色皮帽下转向画外。乌亮的黑眼睛、细胡须和柔和笔触绘出的奶油色口鼻，与帽子的硬接缝和高领红外套上一排金属纽扣形成对比。中央前方，一个额头带暖橙色、竖起一只灰耳的小个子望向左方。它穿着有细亮扣件和斜肩带的合身红夹克；一只浅色小手伸向前方，握住一根深色细杆。其后还有一张面孔藏在较大同伴之间的阴影里。右侧前景是一位白脸伙伴，戴着高高折起的深红帽子。一枚圆形金属镜片或护目镜横在额前，金色配件、绳索及蓝灰色衣料挤在肩膀周围。细胡须与小黑眼睛使这些动物显得温和，尽管制服与装备十分繁复。最左侧边缘，深色的手和一件斜置的狭长物件与大红外套交叠，再添一层紧密的前景，而不把场景展开为开阔环境。柔光从左上及正前方落下，照亮口鼻、皮帽、黄铜细节和夹克纽扣，群像背后的空间几乎保持黑色。细微笔触和层叠的暗色让毛皮、布料与金属各有质感；眼睛及配件周围边缘较锐，身体融入暗背景处则柔化。整体构图亲近而有戏剧感，圆大的头部、拥挤配件以及克制的红、奶油白与蓝绿色营造好奇的故事书气氛。
style_prompt_en: The image has a richly layered fantasy painting surface, with soft brushed transitions over rounded volumes and crisp little accents set into them. Deep blue green and near black fill the recesses, while warm russet red and muted cream occupy the prominent areas; small brass and silver highlights punctuate the low light palette. Forms overlap tightly from edge to edge, so shallow space is expressed through occlusion and selective sharpness rather than through an open horizon. Fine fibrous marks soften broad surfaces, while polished spots and narrow seams provide contrasting textures. Gentle frontal light from one upper side models the exposed planes, and shadow gathers strongly between layers. Edges around focal details are precise, fading into dark painterly passages near the frame boundary. The overall treatment is ornate and intimate, with tactile material contrasts held together by warm highlights inside a deep shadow field.
style_prompt_zh: 图像表面具有层次丰富的奇幻绘画质感，圆润体积以柔和笔触过渡，内部再嵌入清晰的小亮点。深蓝绿色与近黑色填满凹处，暖锈红和低饱和奶油白占据显眼面积；少量黄铜色与银色高光点破低照度配色。形体从边缘到边缘紧密交叠，浅空间主要靠遮挡与选择性锐利建立，而非开阔地平线。细纤维状笔痕柔化大块表面，抛光亮点和窄接缝则提供对照肌理。来自一侧上方的温和正面光塑造暴露的平面，阴影强烈聚在各层之间。焦点细节周围边缘精确，靠近画边则融入深色绘画笔触。整体处理华丽而亲近，触感各异的材质由深影中的暖色高光串联。
theme_en: A crowded fantasy painting of small rabbit-like travelers in red uniforms
theme_zh: 穿红色制服的小兔形旅伴们挤在一起的奇幻绘画
name: Greg Simkins
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
